events.title: Elmgreen & Dragset: Stillleben mit Gemüse (Städel)
events.description: On view since 20 May 2026 and through 17 January 2027: the artist duo Elmgreen & Dragset transform the Städel into a play of reality and illusion with sculptures, installations and staged 'still lifes'. Their interventions dialogue with 700 years of the collection across the whole museum. Museum open Tue–Sun 10–18, Thu 10–21.
events.cost_per_person: Adults €16, reduced €14 (special exhibition surcharge may apply)
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: W.I.M. Im Lauf der Zeit – Eine Wim Wenders Ausstellung (DFF)
events.description: Through 1 November 2026 the DFF – Deutsches Filminstitut & Filmmuseum presents the major retrospective 'W.I.M. – Over the Years' on Wim Wenders' life and work: scripts, photographs, props and costumes, plus an immersive hexagonal installation conceived by Wenders himself with image worlds from his key films. A must for cineastes on the Museumsufer.
events.location: DFF – Deutsches Filminstitut & Filmmuseum, Schaumainkai 41, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Samizdat – Words of Freedom in Czechoslovakia 1939–1989 (Museum für Kommunikation)
events.description: From 20 August 2026 to 24 January 2027 the Museum für Kommunikation Frankfurt shows 'Samizdat – Worte der Freiheit': typewritten, secretly circulated literature and dissident media from Czechoslovakia, complementing the Czech Guest-of-Honour year at the Book Fair. Hand-made books, underground tapes and the courage of their makers. Open Tue–Sun.
events.location: Museum für Kommunikation Frankfurt, Schaumainkai 53, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Katharina Greve: Qualitätsideen seit 1972 (Caricatura Museum)
events.description: Through 17 January 2027 the Caricatura Museum Frankfurt shows 'Katharina Greve – Qualitätsideen seit 1972', a retrospective of the comic artist and cartoonist ('Das wesentliche'). Satirical everyday wisdom from one of Germany's sharpest pens. Also on view: Caricatura Salon #6 'Wir besitzen nichts' until 18 Oct.
events.location: Caricatura Museum Frankfurt, Weckmarkt 17, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Adler, Orden, Wahlurne – Redesigning Democratic Representation (MAK)
events.description: From 28 August 2026 to 21 February 2027 the Museum Angewandte Kunst explores how states represent themselves: eagles, medals, ballot boxes and democratic visual design from the 19th century to today. Design objects, posters and state symbols ask how democracy wants to be seen. Open Tue–Sun 10–18.
events.location: Museum Angewandte Kunst, Schaumainkai 17, 60594 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Damals 1410 – media-literacy exhibition for ages 8+ (Junges Museum)
events.description: Until 7 February 2027 the Junges Museum Frankfurt (inside the Historisches Museum) presents 'Damals 1410': what did news, rumours and images mean in the Middle Ages, and what do they mean today? An interactive media-literacy exhibition for children from age 8 and their families.
events.location: Junges Museum Frankfurt, Saalhof 1 (Historisches Museum), 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: TOO HOT! Heiße Städte, Neue Wege (Deutsches Architekturmuseum)
events.description: Through 7 February 2027 the DAM shows 'TOO HOT! Hot Cities, New Paths' on urban heat and climate adaptation in architecture and planning — from cool facades to green infrastructure. On view alongside the DAM's exhibition 'Suburbia – Träume vom Eigenheim' (until 18 Oct 2026). Open Tue–Sun 10–18.
events.location: Deutsches Architekturmuseum (DAM), Schaumainkai 43, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Höchst erzählt! (Museum im Bolongaropalast)
events.description: Until 28 February 2027 the Historisches Museum's branch in Höchst presents 'Höchst erzählt! Über das Museum im Bolongaropalast' — stories of the former textile town on the Nidda, its palace and its people. Combines with a stroll through Höchst's historic old town and the Höchster Schloss.
events.location: Museum im Bolongaropalast (Historisches Museum Frankfurt), Bolongarostraße 109, 65939 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Freund*innenschaft (Kunsthalle Mainz)
events.description: Since 21 August 2026 (until 10 January 2027) the Kunsthalle Mainz presents the group exhibition 'Freund*innenschaft' on friendship as artistic and social practice, curated by Marlène Harles. Works by Eva Koťátková, Hanne Lippard, Raphaela Simon, Tuomo Manninen and Roxane Mbanga fill the hall at the Zollhafen. The Kunsthalle is currently fighting for its future — support by visiting.
events.location: Kunsthalle Mainz, Am Zollhafen 3–5, 55118 Mainz

events.title: Gutenberg-Museum MOVED – interim exhibition (Mainz)
events.description: During the renovation of the Gutenberg-Museum, the interim exhibition 'Gutenberg-Museum MOVED' presents the highlights of the world's oldest printing museum — including the two Gutenberg Bibles — in rooms of the Naturhistorisches Museum Mainz (opened July 2026, runs through the construction phase). Printing demonstrations, the reconstruction of Gutenberg's workshop and 550-year-old technology.
events.location: Gutenberg-Museum MOVED @ Naturhistorisches Museum Mainz, Reichklarastraße 1, 55116 Mainz

events.title: On Display. How graphic design shapes us (Museum Angewandte Kunst)
events.description: Until 8 November 2026 the MAK shows 'On Display. Wie Grafikdesign uns gestaltet' — how graphic design organises perception, opinion and everyday life, from information design to manipulation. Posters, interfaces and campaigns dissected in the design galleries on the Museumsufer.
events.location: Museum Angewandte Kunst, Schaumainkai 17, 60594 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Senckenberg Naturmuseum – dinosaurs & Sargassum special show
events.description: Senckenberg's permanent exhibition with the famous dinosaur skeletons is open daily 9:00–17:00; the special show 'Sargassum – Fluch und Segen' (27 Mar – 18 Oct 2026) examines the Atlantic seaweed bloom between environmental catastrophe and unique habitat, with the film 'Beyond Sargassum'. Note: the Natur+Medizin hall is closed 7–24 Sep for the new special-exhibition build-up; museum lift renewal 28 Sep – 2 Oct.
events.location: Senckenberg Naturmuseum Frankfurt, Senckenberganlage 25, 60325 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurter Oktoberfest 2026 (Zeltfest am Deutsche-Bank-Park)
events.description: Bavarian-style Oktoberfest tents on the P9 event site next to Deutsche Bank Park, running 9 September – 11 October 2026. Evening sessions 17:30–24:00 with live bands and party music; Sundays open with a Frühschoppen brunch session from 10:30. Food stands serve Oktoberfest classics and beer.
events.location: Eventgelände P9, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurter Herbst-Dippemess 2026 (opening)
events.description: Frankfurt's traditional autumn fair opens 11 September 2026 at 18:00 at the Kettenkarussell (Wellenflug) on the Festplatz am Ratsweg and runs until 27 September. Opening hours: Tue–Thu 15:00–23:00, Fri 15:00–24:00, Sat 14:00–24:00, Sun 12:00–23:00, closed Mondays. Rides, shooting galleries, candy stalls and the Tuesday 'Knirpse-Kirmes' kids' special (15:00–20:00, offers for children under 12).
events.location: Festplatz am Ratsweg, Am Bornheimer Hang, 60386 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Blumenmarkt am Liebfrauenberg (weekly flower market)
events.description: Weekly flower and plant market on the Liebfrauenberg in the city centre, held every Friday through 30 October 2026 (approx. 9:00–17:00). Florists and growers sell seasonal blooms, potted plants and autumn decorations. A green pause in the middle of the banking district.
events.location: Liebfrauenberg, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Rheinhessen-Derby: 1. FSV Mainz 05 vs Eintracht Frankfurt (Bundesliga)
events.description: Bundesliga matchday 3: Mainz 05 host neighbours Eintracht Frankfurt in the Rhine-Main derby at the MEWA ARENA (kick-off 15:30, confirmed by both clubs' schedule pages). One of the most atmospheric fixtures of the season for fans of both cities. Tickets via the clubs' official shops.
events.location: MEWA ARENA, Eugen-Salomon-Straße 1, 55128 Mainz

events.title: Premiere: Der Besuch der alten Dame (Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: Season premiere of Dürrenmatt's tragicomic classic 'The Visit' at the Staatstheater Mainz, directed for the Große Haus. The millionairess Claire Zachanassian returns to her impoverished hometown and offers a gruesome deal. Further performances 20 & 26 Sep, 3, 6, 25 & 29 Oct.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Flohmarkt am Schaumainkai (Museumsufer flea market)
events.description: Frankfurt's most famous flea market along the Museumsufer, held every second Saturday (next dates 12 & 26 Sep, 10 & 24 Oct, 7 & 21 Nov 2026, 9:00–14:00). Antiques, vinyl, books, second-hand fashion and bric-a-brac between the museums. Cash is king; arrive early for the best finds.
events.location: Schaumainkai (Museumsufer), 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Wasserhäusje-Tag 2026 – Frankfurt's first official kiosk day
events.description: Frankfurt celebrates its iconic green kiosks ('Wasserhäusjer') for the first time with an official citywide kiosk day on 12 September 2026, 11:00–22:00. Dozens of participating kiosks across all districts offer specials, art, talks and neighbourhood programmes honouring 150 years of kiosk culture. Programme highlights include science, architecture and photography projects presented at the stalls.
events.location: Participating Wasserhäusjer citywide, Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Tage der Industriekultur Rhein-Main (final weekend)
events.description: The region-wide industrial heritage festival 'Tage der Industriekultur Rhein-Main' (5–13 September 2026, theme 'Auf dem Weg in die Moderne') opens factories, museums and usually inaccessible industrial sites in Frankfurt, Mainz and the whole region. Highlights this weekend include the Frankfurt Feldbahnmuseum, the Peter-Behrens-Bau, guided tours and the SCAPE° youth workshops. Many tours require advance registration.
events.location: Various sites across Frankfurt am Main & Rhein-Main

events.title: Schlemmermarkt an der Kleinmarkthalle (street food market)
events.description: Every Saturday (8:00–16:00) the western forecourt of the Kleinmarkthalle becomes a gourmet street-food and farmers' market with regional produce, snacks and delicacies. A relaxed weekend market atmosphere directly next to Frankfurt's famous indoor food hall.
events.location: Kleinmarkthalle (west forecourt), Hasengasse 5–7, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Amel Bashier: Essence of Life (MMK Frankfurt)
events.description: Opening 12 September 2026 (until 10 January 2027): the MMK presents the first institutional solo show of Sudanese artist Amel Bashier, 'Essence of Life'. Her luminous, large-format paintings place women as creators, survivors and bearers of hope, drawing on Nubian, Assyrian and Indian visual traditions. Open Tue–Sun 10–18, Wed 10–20.
events.location: MMK Museum für Moderne Kunst, Domstraße 10, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Oper Frankfurt: Mazeppa – Premiere (Tchaikovsky)
events.description: Premiere of Tchaikovsky's rarely staged 'Mazeppa' opens the autumn at the Frankfurt Opera House (13 Sep 2026, 18:00). The Ukrainian hetman's tragedy of love, power and betrayal features the Oper Frankfurt chorus and orchestra in a new production. One of the highlights of the 2026/27 season with further performances through the autumn.
events.location: Oper Frankfurt (Opernhaus), Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Die Zauberflöte – Mozart (Staatstheater Mainz, matinee)
events.description: Mozart's 'The Magic Flute' as a Sunday matinee at the Staatstheater Mainz (introductory talk at 14:15). A family-friendly production of the fairy-tale opera with Sarastro, Pamina and Papageno. Further performances 25 Sep, 7 & 23 & 30 Oct 2026.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Tag des offenen Denkmals in Frankfurt
events.description: Germany's national Open Monument Day (13 September 2026) opens historic buildings, courtyards and churches across Frankfurt with free tours, concerts and children's programmes. The city programme spans the Römer, Paulskirche, Höchst old town and many villas of the Museumsufer. Programme details published by the city and the national Denkmalschutz foundation.
events.location: Historic monuments citywide, Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Tag des offenen Denkmals in Mainz
events.description: Open Monument Day in Mainz on 13 September 2026 opens otherwise locked rooms, churches and archaeological sites across the state capital. Highlights include the Justinuskirche (open 11:30–19:00 with guided talks) and special tours of the Roman Theatre excavations. Free guided walks through 2,000 years of city history.
events.location: Monuments across Mainz (e.g. Justinuskirche, Römisches Theater), 55116 Mainz

events.title: Schopenhauer und die Romantik (Deutsches Romantik-Museum)
events.description: Until 13 September 2026: 'Schopenhauer and Romanticism – The way leads inward!' at the Deutsches Romantik-Museum and Frankfurter Goethe-Haus. The exhibition traces how the young Schopenhauer conceived 'The World as Will and Representation' amid the Romantic era. Combined ticket with the Goethe-Haus, Großer Hirschgraben.
events.location: Deutsches Romantik-Museum & Goethe-Haus, Großer Hirschgraben 23–25, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Inspiration Struwwelpeter – contemporary positions (Struwwelpeter-Museum)
events.description: Until 13 September 2026 the Struwwelpeter-Museum on the gallery floor shows 'Inspiration Struwwelpeter': contemporary artists from Angela Bugdahl to James Krüss respond to Heinrich Hoffmann's children's classic. The permanent collection with Hoffmann's original picture-book history remains open for families. Small, charming museum in the Westend.
events.location: Struwwelpeter-Museum, Schubertstraße 20, 60325 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Reise nach … Rom! The Eternal City on Paper (Landesmuseum Mainz)
events.description: Until 13 September 2026 the Landesmuseum Mainz's cabinet show 'Reise nach … Rom!' presents Rome as seen by travelling artists on paper — vedute, ruins and architectural dreams from the graphic collection. Small but exquisite; final days.
events.location: Landesmuseum Mainz, Große Bleiche 49–51, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Jens Balzer: 'Confusion Is Next' – reading & talk (Mainz)
events.description: Cultural critic Jens Balzer presents his new book 'Confusion Is Next' in the series of readings and conversations at the Staatstheater Mainz (15 Sep 2026, 20:00). The evening explores pop culture, punk and the politics of the present. Part of the theatre's literary programme at the 'Zum Grünen Kakadu' restaurant stage.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Maria Magdalena – Zwischen Sünderin und Heiliger (Städel & Liebieghaus)
events.description: Opening 17 September 2026: the first comprehensive German-language exhibition on Mary Magdalene, shown jointly by the Städel Museum and the Liebieghaus Skulpturensammlung until 17 January 2027. Around 100 paintings, sculptures and graphic works from Dürer and Cranach to Beckmann and Lotte Laserstein trace the changing image of the penitent saint. One ticket covers both houses on the Museumsufer.
events.location: Städel Museum & Liebieghaus, Schaumainkai 63/71, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: FOODTURA Festival Frankfurt 2026
events.description: FOODTURA (18–27 September 2026) is Frankfurt's decentralised festival for food culture and sustainability, with events at venues across the city and the Rhein-Main region: tastings, talks, workshops and urban food projects. The festival day 'Gastro Con' on 21 September offers a separate programme for hospitality professionals. Most individual events are free or low-cost; check the programme online.
events.location: Various venues across Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt vs SC Freiburg (home match)
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt host SC Freiburg at Deutsche Bank Park on Bundesliga matchday 4 (Saturday 19 September 2026, 15:30). The Eagles aim to extend their strong home record in front of up to 58,000 fans. Tickets via the official Eintracht ticket shop.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Last chance: Bruegel Printed – The Printed Graphic Work (Städel)
events.description: The Städel's print cabinet exhibition 'Bruegel Printed' ends 20 September 2026: it shows Pieter Bruegel the Elder's printed graphic work — engravings and etchings after the Flemish master that spread his imagery across Europe. Final days to see the show in the museum's print galleries on the Museumsufer.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Last chance: The World through AI (Schirn Kunsthalle)
events.description: Final days (until 20 September 2026) of the Schirn exhibition 'The World through AI', a cooperation with the Jeu de Paume Paris examining how artificial intelligence sees and shapes our world — from Kate Crawford & Vladan Joler's 'Anatomy of an AI System' to Holly Herndon & Mat Dryhurst. A timely show on the politics of machine vision.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt, Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: FRATOPIA Festival Frankfurt (at the Alte Oper)
events.description: FRATOPIA (23–27 September 2026) transforms the Alte Oper and Opernplatz into a free open-air festival of ideas, art and science on the future of society. Talks, installations, music and participatory formats for all ages under the motto of a liveable tomorrow. Free admission to most of the programme.
events.location: Alte Oper Frankfurt & Opernplatz, Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Mainz leuchtet – Das Late Light Festival 2026
events.description: For three evenings (24–26 September 2026, 20:00–23:00) light and video projections designed by Mainz University of Applied Sciences students illuminate the city centre from the Rheingoldhalle to Schillerplatz. The fourth edition of the free 'Late Light Festival' turns historic façades into giant canvases. Free to stroll; food and Rheinhessen wine stalls along the route.
events.location: Rheingoldhalle – Schillerplatz route, 55116 Mainz

events.title: GRENZENLOS Kulturfestival (Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: The international inclusive performing-arts festival GRENZENLOS takes place at the Staatstheater Mainz from 24 September to 4 October 2026 with guest productions from the UK, Spain and beyond (FlawBored, Cia. Vero Cendoya, Michael Turinsky), festival parties and talks. Programme centres on accessibility, disability culture and boundary-crossing art. Individual shows are ticketed, many events are low-threshold.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: DEL ice hockey: Löwen Frankfurt vs Nürnberg Ice Tigers (home opener)
events.description: The Frankfurt Lions open their PENNY DEL home season on Friday 25 September 2026 against the Nürnberg Ice Tigers at the Eissporthalle am Ratsweg (face-off ~19:30). Hesse's top ice hockey club returns with a new-look roster for 2026/27. Tickets from the Löwen ticket shop.
events.location: NIX Eissporthalle Frankfurt, Am Bornheimer Hang 4, 60386 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: In der Strafkolonie – Philip Glass chamber opera (Mainz)
events.description: Premiere of Philip Glass's chamber opera 'In the Penal Colony' after Franz Kafka at the Staatstheater Mainz (26 Sep 2026, 19:30). The one-act score turns Kafka's gruesome parable of justice and machines into a hypnotic music-theatre event. Further performances on 7 and 23 October.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Schall und Rausch – Die grenzenlose Party (Mainz)
events.description: The big festival night of GRENZENLOS 2026 at the Staatstheater Mainz: 'Schall und Rausch' (26 Sep, late evening) celebrates inclusive clubbing with DJs, accessible dance floor and a mixed, open-minded crowd. Dress code: comfortable shoes and joy. Part of the festival's 24 Sep – 4 Oct programme.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Last chance: Mishpocha – The Art of Collaboration (Jewish Museum)
events.description: Final weekend (until 27 September 2026) of 'Mishpocha – The Art of Collaboration' at the Jewish Museum Frankfurt, exploring how artistic families, couples and collectives — from the Rothschilds to contemporary duos — shaped modern art and culture. Paintings, photographs and archival treasures from April to September 2026.
events.location: Jüdisches Museum Frankfurt, Bertha-Pappenheim-Platz 1, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: Zaide – Mozart (Oper Frankfurt, Bockenheimer Depot)
events.description: Premiere of Mozart's unfinished singspiel 'Zaide' at the Bockenheimer Depot (30 Sep 2026, 19:00) — the story of the enslaved Zaide and her lover Gomatz, with the famous quartet and chorus music Mozart left behind. A rare repertoire piece in the intimate Depot setting. Further performances through October.
events.location: Oper Frankfurt – Bockenheimer Depot, Carlo-Schmid-Platz 1, 60486 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: GRENZENLOS-Kino: 'Luisa' – film screening (Mainz)
events.description: Film screening of Julia Roesler's 'Luisa' at the U17 stage of the Staatstheater Mainz as part of the GRENZENLOS festival (30 Sep 2026, 19:30). The festival cinema slot presents a feature on identity and self-determination. Part of the inclusive culture festival running 24 Sep – 4 Oct.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (U17), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Blues Caravan – Live 2026 (Ruf Records tour, Frankfurt)
events.description: The legendary Ruf Records 'Blues Caravan' rolls into the Club of the Jahrhunderthalle on 1 October 2026 (20:00), with powerhouse guitarist-singer Ana Popovic alongside French guitarist Elise Frank. Three decades of the label's blues-rock tradition on one stage.
events.location: Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt (Club), Pfaffenwiese 301, 65929 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: Lohengrin – Richard Wagner (Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: Season highlight: the premiere of Wagner's 'Lohengrin' at the Staatstheater Mainz on 4 October 2026 at 17:00, followed by the premiere party. Elsa's forbidden question to the Grail knight becomes the motto of the entire 2026/27 season. Further performances 24 Oct, 1 & 6 & 21 Nov.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Stadtbilder – Ursula Edelmann zum 100. Geburtstag (Historisches Museum)
events.description: Until 4 October 2026 the Historisches Museum Frankfurt honours Frankfurt photographer Ursula Edelmann (1926–2026) on her 100th birthday: 'Stadtbilder – Ikonen des Stadtwandels' captures the rebuilding and transformation of Frankfurt after 1945. Icons of urban change by one of the city's great chroniclers.
events.location: Historisches Museum Frankfurt, Saalhof 1, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026 (77th Book Fair)
events.description: The world's largest book fair runs 7–11 October 2026 at Messe Frankfurt (trade days 7–9 Oct, public days 9–11 Oct). Guest of Honour 2026: Czech Republic under the motto 'A Country at the Coast' with a huge pavilion, readings and exhibitions. Around 4,000 exhibitors; author stages, rights trading and the new hall concept for 2026.
events.location: Messe Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bundesliga: Mainz 05 vs Bayer 04 Leverkusen (home match)
events.description: Mainz 05 welcome defending top-four side Bayer Leverkusen to the MEWA ARENA on Bundesliga matchday 5 (Saturday 10 October 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised, expected 15:30). A tough home test for the 05ers in front of their own crowd. Tickets via the official Mainz 05 shop.
events.location: MEWA ARENA, Eugen-Salomon-Straße 1, 55128 Mainz

events.title: tanzmainz: Fall Seven Times (revival, Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: Revival of 'Fall Seven Times (UA)' by choreographers Guy Nader & Maria Campos with the tanzmainz company in the Kleines Haus (10 Oct 2026, 19:30; intro at 18:45). The acclaimed piece plays with falling, catching and the physics of trust. Further performances 13, 14, 16 & 28 Oct.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Kleines Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Sven Regener: 'Frankie und Freddie' – reading (Buchmesse c/o Staatstheater)
events.description: Element of Crime frontman and bestselling author Sven Regener reads from his new novel 'Frankie und Freddie' at the Staatstheater Mainz's Große Haus (10 Oct 2026, 19:30) — part of the 'Buchmesse c/o Staatstheater' literary series during Book Fair week. An evening of wry Berlin storytelling and music.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Kinderkonzert: 'Auch kleine Dinge können uns entzücken' (Mainz)
events.description: Morning children's concert by the Staatsorchester Mainz at the Staatstheater (10 Oct 2026, 10:00): chamber music gems for the youngest listeners, with instruments introduced playfully. Part of the theatre's family programme for ages 4+.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Flohmarkt am Schaumainkai (Museumsufer flea market)
events.description: The Museumsufer flea market returns on Saturday 10 October 2026 (9:00–14:00) along the Schaumainkai between the museums. Vinyl, vintage, books, furniture and everyday treasures from Frankfurt attics — every second Saturday, next date 24 Oct. Bring cash and haggle with a smile.
events.location: Schaumainkai (Museumsufer), 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Last chance: Grönland – Not For Sale (Frankfurter Kunstverein)
events.description: Final day (until 11 October 2026) of the Frankfurter Kunstverein's political exhibition 'Grönland – Not For Sale – Kalaallit Nunaat Forever' in the Steinernes Haus am Römerberg. Greenlandic artists and international positions look at the Arctic island beyond clichés of ice and igloos — and beyond the headlines. First show of a political-exhibition cycle running to 2028.
events.location: Frankfurter Kunstverein, Markt 44 (Römerberg), 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Last chance: Tiere sind auch nur Menschen – August Gaul (Liebieghaus)
events.description: Until 11 October 2026 the Liebieghaus shows 'Animals are only human too – sculptures by August Gaul', the great animal sculptor of German modernism around 1900. His lions, penguins and bison in bronze and stone are displayed among the collection's 5,000 years of sculpture. Last weekend to see the show.
events.location: Liebieghaus Skulpturensammlung, Schaumainkai 71, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Wiederaufnahme: Falstaff – Verdi (Staatstheater Mainz, matinee)
events.description: Verdi's comic masterpiece 'Falstaff' returns to the Staatstheater Mainz in revival on 11 October 2026 (matinee at 15:00, intro at 14:15). The fat knight of Windsor gets his comeuppance in Shakespeare's last comedy set to Verdi's final, sparkling score.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Premiere: Ottone – Händel (Oper Frankfurt)
events.description: Premiere of Handel's Baroque opera 'Ottone, re di Germania' at the Frankfurt Opera House (11 Oct 2026, 18:00), staged by the house's acclaimed Baroque team. Courtly intrigue, banishment and love in the early 18th-century London of Handel's first Royal Academy season. Further performances through November.
events.location: Oper Frankfurt (Opernhaus), Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Poesie der Nachbarn: Czech poetry evening (Mainz)
events.description: 'Die Seele des Nebels' – poetry from the Czech Republic in German translation, read at the Staatstheater Mainz (12 Oct 2026, 20:00), tying in with the Czech Guest-of-Honour appearance at the Frankfurt Book Fair. Part of the 'Poesie der Nachbarn' series of literary evenings.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Deutsches Jazzfestival Frankfurt 2026 (hr)
events.description: Five days of international contemporary jazz, 13–17 October 2026, at the hr-Sendesaal and its foyer in Frankfurt. Opening night (13 Oct, 19:00, foyer) features Frankfurt saxophonist Christof Lauer with his solo 'Odyssea Sonorium'; across the week: Emile Parisien, Myra Melford, Louis Sclavis and Shake Stew, plus the hr-Bigband. Day and festival passes available from the hr ticket centre.
events.location: hr-Sendesaal Frankfurt, Bertramstraße 8, 60320 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: 2. Sinfoniekonzert: 'Vom Schatten zum Licht' (Staatsorchester Mainz)
events.description: The Staatsorchester Mainz plays its second symphony concert of the season, 'From Shadow to Light', at the Große Haus (16 & 17 Oct 2026, intro at 19:00, concert approx. 19:30). Programme and soloists announced by the Staatstheater Mainz; a journey from dark timbres to radiant major.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt vs 1. FC Köln (home match)
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt host 1. FC Köln at Deutsche Bank Park on Bundesliga matchday 6 (Saturday 17 October 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised). A traditional fixture with a sold-out atmosphere expected in the Waldstadion. Tickets via the Eintracht shop.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Amon Amarth – 'The Allfather Awakens' (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Swedish melodic death metal titans Amon Amarth bring their Europe & UK tour 'The Allfather Awakens' to the Festhalle Frankfurt on 17 October 2026 (doors/start 18:30). Viking ships, pyrotechnics and wall-of-death anthems for the metal faithful.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: Ein Mann seiner Klasse (Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: Premiere of the solo play 'Ein Mann seiner Klasse' after Christian Baron's autobiographical novel at the U17 stage of the Staatstheater Mainz (18 Oct 2026, 19:30). Growing up poor in the Palatinate — a searing monologue about class, violence and fatherhood, followed by a premiere party. Further performance 30 Oct.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (U17), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: The World of Hans Zimmer – A New Dimension (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: The spectacular cinema-concert show 'The World of Hans Zimmer – A New Dimension' comes to the Festhalle Frankfurt on 18 October 2026 (19:30). Zimmer's film music from 'Pirates of the Caribbean', 'Inception', 'Dune' and 'The Lion King' performed by a full symphony orchestra, choir and soloists behind a giant LED wall.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Last chances: autumn exhibition ends at DAM, MAK, Senckenberg & Caricatura (18 Oct)
events.description: Four major Frankfurt shows close on 18 October 2026: 'Suburbia – Träume vom Eigenheim' (Deutsches Architekturmuseum), 'Im Modus der Serie' (Museum Angewandte Kunst), 'Sargassum – Fluch und Segen' (Senckenberg Naturmuseum) and Caricatura Salon #6 'Wir besitzen nichts'. Last Sunday to catch all four on one Museumsufer loop.
events.location: Schaumainkai museums & Senckenberganlage 25, Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Opening: Leonor Fini – Magisch Surreal (Schirn Kunsthalle)
events.description: The Schirn opens the first major German retrospective of Leonor Fini (1907–1996) on 23 October 2026 (until 21 February 2027): around 100 paintings, drawings, photographs and objects by the surrealist painter of magical, mythic femininity. Influenced by Renaissance, Symbolism and German Romanticism, Fini's world hovers between dream and masquerade.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt, Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bundesliga: Mainz 05 vs SV Werder Bremen (home match)
events.description: Mainz 05 host SV Werder Bremen at the MEWA ARENA on Bundesliga matchday 7 (Saturday 24 October 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised). A duel of two passionate fan bases. Tickets via the official Mainz 05 shop.
events.location: MEWA ARENA, Eugen-Salomon-Straße 1, 55128 Mainz

events.title: The James Brown Experience – A Tribute to the King of Funk (Frankfurt)
events.description: The James Brown Experience brings the sound of the Godfather of Soul to the Club of the myticket Jahrhunderthalle on 24 October 2026 (20:00). An elaborately produced show with horns, dancers and all the classics from 'I Got You' to 'Sex Machine'. A funk party for the whole family of groove.
events.location: Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt (Club), Pfaffenwiese 301, 65929 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Wiederaufnahme: Das achte Leben (Für Brilka) (Staatstheater Mainz)
events.description: Revival of the epic stage adaptation of Nino Haratischwili's bestselling novel 'Das achte Leben (Für Brilka)' in the Kleines Haus of the Staatstheater Mainz (24 Oct 2026, 19:30; intro 17:15... start 19:30). Six generations of a Georgian family across a century of European history. An evening-length theatrical journey.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Kleines Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Last chance: Fritz Scholder (MMK Tower, until 25 Oct)
events.description: Final weekend (until 25 October 2026) of the first European retrospective of Native American painter Fritz Scholder (1937–2005) at the TOWER MMK in the TaunusTurm. His paintings, drawings and lithographs expand the story of American Pop Art beyond its usual canon — vivid colour, irony and the image of the 'Indian'. Open Tue–Sun 10–18, Wed 10–20.
events.location: TOWER MMK – Museum für Moderne Kunst, Taunustor 1, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Mainova Frankfurt Marathon 2026
events.description: The 45th Mainova Frankfurt Marathon starts at 10:00 on 25 October 2026 on the Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage and winds through the city, along the Main and past the museums to the finish in the Festhalle. Already sold out with over 18,000 registered runners — but cheering is free along the whole course. Also: relay, mini-marathon and pasta party the day before.
events.location: Start: Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage / Finish: Festhalle, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Kevin Barry: 'Ein Herz im Winter' – reading (Mainz)
events.description: Irish writer Kevin Barry presents the German edition of his novel 'Ein Herz im Winter' ('Heart in Winter') at the Staatstheater Mainz (26 Oct 2026, 20:00). A love story set in 1890s San Francisco, praised as one of the novels of the year. Reading and conversation in the theatre's literary series.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz, Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Disney in Concert – Die Jubiläumstournee (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Disney's anniversary concert tour with the Hollywood Sound Orchestra arrives at the Festhalle Frankfurt on 28 October 2026 (19:30). Beloved Disney film music from 100 years of animation, live to picture — a magical family night for all ages.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Placebo – 30th Anniversary Tour (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Placebo celebrate three decades with their 30th Anniversary Tour at the Festhalle Frankfurt on 29 October 2026 (20:00). Brian Molko and Stefan Olsdal play the anthems from 'Without You I'm Nothing' to 'Never Let Me Go' in a career-spanning set.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Marteria – 'Zum Glück in die Zukunft' Tour (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Rostock rapper Marteria brings his 'Zum Glück in die Zukunft' tour to the Festhalle Frankfurt on 30 October 2026 (19:30). The last of the legendary 365-Tage-Rapper's stadium-scale shows with his band, brass section and a full light show — from 'Verstrahlt' to 'Lila Wolken'.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt vs Hamburger SV (home match)
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt host Hamburger SV at Deutsche Bank Park on Bundesliga matchday 8 (Saturday 31 October 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised). A classic north-south duel with rich history. Tickets via the Eintracht shop.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Staatsorchester meets … HALLOWEEN (Mainz)
events.description: New concert series 'Staatsorchester meets …' opens with a Halloween special at the Große Haus of the Staatstheater Mainz on 31 October 2026 (19:00–20:40). Spooky film music and danse macabre favourites played by the Staatsorchester — 'everyone is welcome', costumes encouraged.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Don Toliver – NITROUS: OCTANE World Tour Leg 2 (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: US rapper and singer Don Toliver brings the second leg of his 'NITROUS: OCTANE' world tour to the Festhalle Frankfurt on 31 October 2026 (20:00) — a Halloween-night arena show of psychedelic trap and autotune soul. Support acts and full production announced by the promoter.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: Der Zauberer von Oz – musical for families (Mainz)
events.description: Premiere of 'The Wizard of Oz' (after L. Frank Baum) as a family musical at the Große Haus of the Staatstheater Mainz on 3 November 2026 (10:00, school/premiere slot; public matinees 7 Nov 15:00 and 22 Nov 15:00). Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Man and the Cowardly Lion — a colourful journey for ages 6+.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Tokio Hotel – Arena Tour 2026 (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Tokio Hotel return to Frankfurt with their Arena Tour 2026 at the Festhalle on 5 November 2026 (20:00). Bill and Tom Kaulitz present new material alongside the hits of 'Schrei', 'Humanoid' and their later electronic phase. A nostalgia-plus-future show for fans old and new.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Deep Purple – SPLAT! World Tour 2026 (Festhalle Frankfurt)
events.description: Hard rock legends Deep Purple bring their 'SPLAT! World Tour' (named after their 2026 album) to the Festhalle Frankfurt on 6 November 2026 (19:30). Smoke on the Water, Highway Star and the full catalogue of proto-metal classics, five decades on.
events.location: Festhalle Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bundesliga: Mainz 05 vs FC Bayern München (home match)
events.description: Mainz 05 host record champions FC Bayern Munich at the MEWA ARENA on Bundesliga matchday 9 (Saturday 7 November 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised). The 05ers have famously beaten Bayern several times in front of their own fans. Tickets via the official Mainz 05 shop — likely to sell out fast.
events.location: MEWA ARENA, Eugen-Salomon-Straße 1, 55128 Mainz

events.title: Letz Zep – The Led Zeppelin Tribute No. 1 (Frankfurt)
events.description: Letz Zep, internationally acclaimed as the world's best Led Zeppelin tribute, play their 'Celebration Tour' at the Club of the myticket Jahrhunderthalle on 7 November 2026 (20:00). Whole Lotta Love, Stairway to Heaven and Kashmir performed with period instruments and Plant-esque vocals.
events.location: Jahrhunderthalle Frankfurt (Club), Pfaffenwiese 301, 65929 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Flohmarkt am Schaumainkai (Museumsufer flea market)
events.description: Late-autumn edition of the Museumsufer flea market on Saturday 7 November 2026 (9:00–14:00) along the Schaumainkai. Winter coats, vinyl and early Christmas-vintage treasures; next date 21 Nov. Free entry, all along the river between the museums.
events.location: Schaumainkai (Museumsufer), 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Premiere: Le Roi Arthus – Chausson (Oper Frankfurt)
events.description: Frankfurt Opera presents the German premiere staging of Ernest Chausson's sole opera 'Le Roi Arthus' on 8 November 2026 (18:00) — the late-Romantic grail epic about King Arthur's fall, rarely heard outside France. A major rarity of the 2026/27 season with the Oper Frankfurt orchestra in the pit.
events.location: Oper Frankfurt (Opernhaus), Opernplatz 1, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: 3. Sinfoniekonzert: 'Energy Concert' (Staatsorchester Mainz)
events.description: The Staatsorchester Mainz's third symphony concert, 'Energy Concert', on 13 & 14 November 2026 at the Große Haus (intro 19:00). High-voltage repertoire programmed around rhythm and power — details via the Staatstheater Mainz. Also: 'Reingehört' lunchtime open rehearsal on 13 Nov at 13:00.
events.location: Staatstheater Mainz (Großes Haus), Gutenbergplatz 7, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Last chance: Fußballfieber – football history of Rhineland-Palatinate (Mainz)
events.description: Final day (until 15 November 2026) of the family exhibition 'Fußballfieber – Fußballgeschichte(n) aus Rheinland-Pfalz' at the Landesmuseum Mainz. From the origins of the game in the region to Mainz 05, kicker stories, cult objects and interactive stations for kids. Open Tue 10–20, Wed–Sun 10–17.
events.location: Landesmuseum Mainz, Große Bleiche 49–51, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Opening: The Parthenon in a New Light (Liebieghaus)
events.description: From 18 November 2026 the Liebieghaus presents a major exhibition on the east pediment of the Parthenon, one of antiquity's most important monuments, newly illuminated by 3D research. Casts and digital reconstructions bring the Athenian temple sculptures to Frankfurt. Runs into 2027.
events.location: Liebieghaus Skulpturensammlung, Schaumainkai 71, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Opening: Friedemann Hahn sieht Vincent van Gogh (Landesmuseum Mainz)
events.description: Opening 19 November 2026: 'Friedemann Hahn sees Vincent van Gogh' at the Landesmuseum Mainz (until 21 February 2027). Contemporary painter Friedemann Hahn enters into a pictorial dialogue with van Gogh — expressive homage paintings face the originals. Open Tue 10–20, Wed–Sun 10–17.
events.location: Landesmuseum Mainz, Große Bleiche 49–51, 55116 Mainz

events.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt vs TSG Hoffenheim (home match)
events.description: Eintracht Frankfurt host TSG Hoffenheim at Deutsche Bank Park on Bundesliga matchday 10 (Saturday 21 November 2026; kick-off time not yet finalised). The last home game before the winter darkness fully sets in. Tickets via the Eintracht shop.
events.location: Deutsche Bank Park, Mörfelder Landstraße 362, 60528 Frankfurt am Main
